leads.title: Senate File 418 - 2025 Iowa Legislative Session
leads.documents: Enacts unchangeable binary legal definition of sex determined at birth and bars transgender people from altering legal gender on government IDs/documents; strips gender transition language added in 2007.
leads.detail: Cited in text as 'Senate File 418 during the 2025 Iowa Legislative Session' effective July 1, 2025. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: February 2025 Iowa bill removing 'gender identity' from anti-discrimination laws
leads.documents: Removes gender identity from Iowa employment, housing and public accommodations protections originally added in 2007; makes Iowa first state to remove protections for a protected class.
leads.detail: Cited as passed with 'veto-proof majority', signed by Governor Kim Reynolds, effective July 1. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Senate File 538 - gender-affirming healthcare ban on children (March 2023)
leads.documents: Bans provision of any and all gender-affirming healthcare to transgender minors in Iowa; requires providers to cease ongoing care within 180 days.
leads.detail: Cited as 'Senate File 538 passed both houses', signed by Governor Kim Reynolds, took effect immediately. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: March 2022 Iowa women's sports law
leads.documents: Limits women's sports to cisgender females based on 'sex at birth' in all accredited public/private educational institutions including colleges; creates civil lawsuit cause for direct or indirect harm from violation.
leads.detail: Cited as passed by Iowa General Assembly, signed by Governor Kim Reynolds, effective July 1, 2022. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Iowa Supreme Court March 2019 Medicaid ruling and legislative reversal
leads.documents: Court declared sex reassignment surgery must be covered under state Medicaid; one month later General Assembly passed bill banning state funding for sex reassignment surgeries, signed by Governor Reynolds, reversing ruling.
leads.detail: Cited as March 2019 ruling, April 2019 final-hours legislative ban, plus November 2021 Polk County District Court ruling ban unconstitutional. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: June 2025 Iowa law banning Medicaid coverage for transgender care
leads.documents: Bans Medicaid coverage for transgender surgeries and hormone treatments, effective July 1, 2025.
leads.detail: Cited as signed by Governor Reynolds in June 2025. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Iowa hate crime law and March 8, 2016 Senate bill
leads.documents: State hate crime law provides penalty enhancements for sexual orientation but not gender identity; Senate approved 27-21 bill to add gender identity which died in Republican-controlled House.
leads.detail: Cited as March 8, 2016 27-21 vote. Federal coverage noted via Matthew Shepard and James Byrd, Jr. Hate Crimes Prevention Act signed October 2009. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Varnum v. Brien - Iowa Supreme Court
leads.documents: Unanimously upheld Polk County District Court ruling requiring state to license/recognize same-sex marriages; basis for marriage licenses issued from April 27, 2009.
leads.detail: Cited as decided April 3, 2009, licenses from April 27, 2009. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: May 2023 Iowa classroom law (K-6)
leads.documents: Bans sexual orientation and gender identity lessons in Iowa school classrooms Kindergarten to grade 6.
leads.detail: Cited as passed by Iowa Legislature and signed by Governor in May 2023. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: 2025-2026 Iowa civil rights preemption measures
leads.documents: 2025 law stripping nondiscrimination protections from trans people prompted city-level protections; 2026 bill bans localities from having civil rights protections stronger or broader than state government.
leads.detail: Cited as 2025 stripping law and 2026 locality-ban response. No URL visible in provided text.
